slot_scores.name: unknown_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the specific objective of this production plan, such as maximizing total profit, maximizing total units produced, or minimizing total production cost
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective before READY_TO_MODEL, and the follow-up question on Turn 2 confirmed the objective is the number of completed products (min of component totals).

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 hidden slot (objective) was explicitly asked and resolved before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent clearly probed the sole P0 hidden slot, confirming the objective as maximizing completed products and the product definition, then reasonably entered READY_TO_MODEL. Remaining items (e.g., integrality) are not part of the hidden slots and were flagged as explicit assumptions rather than silently adopted.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
